notes.title: Bug Fix (July 11, 2024)
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where the behavior was not normal when using Angel+ consecutively.

notes.title: Update: Ultimate Mode
notes.notes:
Ultimate Mode: Added a new mode called "Inverted God." This mode offers a different atmosphere of gameplay rather than being extremely difficult. You will face the final boss in a situation where "if you inscribe a verse, it will no longer appear normally," and you must have exorcised a total of 44 or more demons to proceed with the exorcism.

The specifications of Protection+ will be nerfed in all modes.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where the completion button sometimes does not appear after displaying the message for completing an exorcism.
